facts.value: AKKS Trondheim er en idealistisk organisasjon som vil rekruttere, synliggjøre og motivere kvinner i musikkbransjen. summary: AKKS TRONDHEIM (org. no. 979 639 813) is an association (FLI) based in Trondheim, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-03-02. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 6 registered employees. CEO: Emely Ruth Waet; board chair: Marit Glimstad.

gaps.reason: Legal form FLI is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
